evidence: 373 files / 236 unique PDB IDs. Full-archive scan: 278/280 VH-containing files show VH+CH1 paired with a separate VL+CL entity (~160-300 aa, classic Fab format, no CH2/CH3). Only 2/280 (0.7%) show a heavy-chain entity >300 aa. One such case (9NCD) verified against RCSB: full deposited entry has 4 polymer entities, max length 451 aa (VH+CH1+hinge+CH2+CH3, i.e. genuine Fc), and the Fc chain WAS retained in this crop. Zero PDB-ID overlap with the other two Fab-like archives (150035, 150654).
notes: Cannot be confidently assigned to FAB vs FAB+FC from crop content: >99% of entries in this archive show no Fc at all, so this is not a clean Fab+Fc cohort by content, yet it is not identical in ID composition to the archive assigned FAB (150654) either. No summary CSV was included in any archive to supply the original SAbDab2 category label. Requires Stage 1 systematic verification (RCSB full-entity-length lookup across all 236 PDB IDs) before use in the primary paired cohort.

evidence: 1033 files / 604 unique PDB IDs. Full-archive scan: 830/845 VH-containing files are plain Fab format (160-300 aa); 13/845 (1.5%) show heavy-chain entity length 300-451 aa. notes: Same ambiguity as 145541: >98% Fab-only by content, so not a clean Fab+Fc cohort, but a slightly higher Fc-positive rate (1.5% vs 0.7%) than 145541 and much higher than 150654 (0.1%) is weak, non-conclusive evidence this archive could be more Fc-enriched. Not sufficient for a confident assignment. Requires Stage 1 RCSB-based verification across all 604 IDs.
